description: Taps a point with one finger (Input.dispatchTouchEvent): the page gets touch and pointer events with pointerType "touch". The first touch action turns on touch emulation for the window (maxTouchPoints, pointer: coarse).

window.description: Window: target id from list_windows or part of its title. Optional when only one window is open.

x.description: x coordinate, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

y.description: y coordinate, normalized 0–1 over the screenshot

name: tap
title: Tap
